evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: what date are you planning to move? [October 24th] ... what type of move are we doing? [house to house] ... can I have the pickup location address? [2310 Mansfield Lane, Cedar Park] ... what's the size of the house and how many stories and bedrooms? [2700 square feet, one story]
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: So since this is a large move, I will go ahead and endorse this to a large move specialist. So I would just like to confirm your contact number is 817-501-6723... please expect a call back within the day from our a large move specialist to provide you an accurate estimate
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked — rep moved directly from name/date/location into logistics probing without asking about concerns or goals for the call
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Gathered: property type (house), stories (1 story at origin, 2 stories at destination), bedrooms (none at origin since furniture already in storage; 5 at destination), parking (yes at destination). Missing: walking distance, additional rooms, special considerations beyond the split storage situation. The split storage complicates count but was not fully explored as a logistics detail.

top_strength: Rep correctly identified the move as large (multiple stops, storage units involved) and routed it to a specialist rather than trying to quote on the spot, protecting quote accuracy.
coaching_note: Before routing to a specialist, ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' — you skipped Their Agenda entirely, missing the chance to brief the specialist on what matters most to Andrea.
